name: relay-cli-monorepo
description: Local-first context and prompt-cache optimizer for coding CLIs.

scripts.ci: pnpm build && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm pack:check
scripts.pack:check: pnpm clean && pnpm build && npm pack --dry-run --cache /tmp/npm-cache ./packages/core && npm pack --dry-run --cache /tmp/npm-cache ./packages/cli
